content: structlog's ExceptionDictTransformer can dump frame locals (tokens/passwords) in tracebacks; structlog docs recommend show_locals=False or a custom redact_frames subclass. Processors are (logger, method, event_dict)->event_dict callables run in a chain; redaction removing from locals does not guarantee removal from the rendered exception string elsewhere -- a known gap that motivates a renderer-level backstop independent of the processor chain.
